name: Cabbage Soup With Cauliflower, Chickpeas, and Coconut Milk

ingredients.name: fresh ginger, peeled and finely chopped
unsweetened full-fat coconut milk, shaken well before use

instructions.primary_message: In a large Dutch oven, heat oil over medium-high until shimmering. Add onion and carrots. Cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3 to 5 minutes. Stir in garlic, ginger, cumin, pepper, turmeric, and smoked paprika, and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add cabbage and cook, stirring often, until cabbage turns bright green, about 2 minutes.

Stir in broth, chickpeas, diced tomatoes, cauliflower, and salt. Bring mixture to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until cabbage and cauliflower are tender, 25 to 30 minutes.
Stir in coconut milk and return to a simmer. Cook, stirring occasionally, until warmed through, about 2 minutes. Divide soup among serving bowls and top with cilantro. Serve with lime wedges.

schema_metadata.keywords: cabbage soup, soup, vegetable soup, winter soup, cauliflower soup, coconut milk soup

description: This one-pot cabbage soup delivers a brothy, flavorful, and satisfying meal in under an hour.
notes:
Optional or for serving: Chopped fresh cilantro leaves and tender stems, for serving; Lime wedges, for serving

Optional substitutions: homemade chicken stock → store-bought low-sodium chicken broth or vegetable broth

Notes: We like the flavor that chicken stock brings to this soup, but if you prefer to keep it vegan, feel free to substitute low-sodium vegetable broth for the chicken stock.

Make-ahead and storage: Leftovers can be refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 4 days. Reheat gently on the stovetop or in the microwave.
author: Laila Ibrahim
